```{ojs}
covSample = {
  const run = Number(covControls.run ?? 0);
  const rng = d3.randomLcg((0.271 + 0.193 * run) % 1 || 0.271);
  const standardNormal = d3.randomNormal.source(rng)(0, 1);
  const residualScale = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - covControls.rho ** 2));

  return d3.range(covControls.n).map(index => {
    const x = standardNormal();
    const residual = standardNormal();
    return {
      index: index + 1,
      x,
      y: covControls.rho * x + residualScale * residual
    };
  });
}

covXMean = d3.mean(covSample, point => point.x)
covYMean = d3.mean(covSample, point => point.y)

covContributions = covSample.map(point => ({
  ...point,
  contribution: (point.x - covXMean) * (point.y - covYMean)
}))

covEmpirical = d3.mean(covContributions, point => point.contribution)
covXSd = Math.sqrt(d3.mean(covSample, point => (point.x - covXMean) ** 2))
covYSd = Math.sqrt(d3.mean(covSample, point => (point.y - covYMean) ** 2))
covCorrelation = covEmpirical / Math.max(1e-12, covXSd * covYSd)

covDomain = [-4, 4]
covQuadrants = [
  {x1: covDomain[0], x2: covXMean, y1: covDomain[0], y2: covYMean, sign: "positive"},
  {x1: covXMean, x2: covDomain[1], y1: covYMean, y2: covDomain[1], sign: "positive"},
  {x1: covDomain[0], x2: covXMean, y1: covYMean, y2: covDomain[1], sign: "negative"},
  {x1: covXMean, x2: covDomain[1], y1: covDomain[0], y2: covYMean, sign: "negative"}
]

covContributionLimit = Math.max(
  0.5,
  d3.max(covContributions, point => Math.abs(point.contribution)) || 0.5
)
```

```{ojs}
covScatterPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 330,
  marginLeft: 52,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",

    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "X", domain: covDomain, grid: true},
  y: {label: "Y", domain: covDomain, grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.rect(covQuadrants, {
      x1: "x1",
      x2: "x2",
      y1: "y1",
      y2: "y2",
      fill: quadrant => quadrant.sign === "positive" ?
        "var(--plot-fill-1)" : "var(--plot-fill-4)"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([covXMean], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 1.8,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([covYMean], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 1.8,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.dot(covContributions, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      r: point => 2.8 + 2.2 * Math.min(1, Math.abs(point.contribution) / 3),
      fill: point => point.contribution >= 0 ?
        "var(--plot-series-1)" : "var(--plot-series-4)",
      fillOpacity: 0.82,

      strokeWidth: 0.55,
      title: point =>
        `(x-x̄)(y-ȳ) = ${point.contribution.toFixed(3)}`

    Plot.text([{x: covXMean, y: covDomain[1] - 0.2, label: "x̄"}], {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      text: "label",
      dx: 7,
      textAnchor: "start",
      fill: "var(--plot-fg)",
      fontSize: 12
    }),
    Plot.text([{x: covDomain[1] - 0.2, y: covYMean, label: "ȳ"}], {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      text: "label",
      dy: -7,
      textAnchor: "end",
      fill: "var(--plot-fg)",
      fontSize: 12
    })
  ]
})

covContributionPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 330,
  marginLeft: 62,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Observation", domain: [0.5, covControls.n + 0.5], axis: null},
  y: {
    label: "Centred product",
    domain: [-1.12 * covContributionLimit, 1.12 * covContributionLimit],
    grid: true
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(covContributions, {
      x1: point => point.index - 0.43,
      x2: point => point.index + 0.43,
      y1: 0,
      y2: "contribution",
      fill: point => point.contribution >= 0 ?
        "var(--plot-series-1)" : "var(--plot-series-4)",
      fillOpacity: 0.78,
      title: point =>
        `Observation ${point.index}: ${point.contribution.toFixed(3)}`
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)"}),
    Plot.ruleY([covEmpirical], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-2)",
      strokeWidth: 2.4,
      strokeDasharray: "6,4"
    }),
    Plot.text([{
      x: covControls.n,
      y: covEmpirical,
      label: "mean product"
    }], {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      text: "label",
      textAnchor: "end",
      dy: covEmpirical >= 0 ? -8 : 14,
      fill: "var(--plot-series-2)",
      fontSize: 12
    })
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
// Keep the controls mounted below the reactive plots so sliders remain draggable.
viewof covControls = {
  const relationshipForm = Inputs.form({
    rho: Inputs.range([-0.95, 0.95], {
      value: 0.7,
      step: 0.05,
      label: md`Population correlation ${tex`\rho`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const sampleForm = Inputs.form({
    n: Inputs.range([20, 200], {
      value: 80,
      step: 10,
      label: md`Sample size ${tex`n`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const drawButton = Inputs.button("Draw a new sample", {
    reduce: value => (value ?? 0) + 1
  });
  drawButton.classList.add("btn-resim");

  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Simulation controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Relationship</h4></div>
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Sample &amp; actions</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  const columns = root.querySelectorAll(".controls-col");
  columns[0].append(relationshipForm);
  columns[1].append(sampleForm);
  const buttonWrap = html`<div style="display:flex; justify-content:flex-start; margin-top:6px;"></div>`;
  buttonWrap.append(drawButton);
  columns[1].append(buttonWrap);

  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {
    get: () => ({
      ...relationshipForm.value,
      ...sampleForm.value,
      run: drawButton.value ?? 0
    })
  });

  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="cov-message"><strong>Read the quadrants:</strong> observations above both means or below both means contribute positively. Observations on opposite sides contribute negatively. Their balance determines the sign and size of the covariance.</p>`
```
